description: Brentuximab vedotin is recommended as an option for treating relapsed or refractory systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma in adults, only if: they have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1 and the company provides brentuximab vedotin according to the commercial access agreement with NHS England.
